application: High-Fluence 1060nm / 1210nm Beam Homogenizer for Non-Invasive Hyperthermic Laser Lipolysis

process_steps.title: Substrate Surface Preparation (Optical Grade Fused Silica SiO2)
protocol: Piranha clean: H2SO4:H2O2 (3:1 volume ratio) at 120°C for 15 minutes to strip trace organics and particulate contaminants.
Cascade deionized (DI) water rinse until resistivity exceeds 18.2 MOhm-cm.
Standard Clean SC-1 (NH4OH:H2O2:H2O 1:1:5 at 70°C for 10 min) to generate dense silanol (-SiOH) surface hydration.
Megasonic agitation at 1.0 MHz for 5 minutes to detach sub-100nm particles.
Dehydration bake: 200°C hotplate bake for 15 minutes in dry nitrogen purge box.

process_steps.title: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Polycrystalline Silicon

parameters.film_stress: Ultra-low tensile (< 80 MPa, annealed at 600°C for 30 min)

parameters.bottom_antireflective_coating: Brewer Science ARC-29A (65 nm thickness, baked at 205°C for 60s)

process_steps.title: Inductively Coupled Plasma Reactive Ion Etching (ICP-RIE)

parameters.etch_chemistry: Pseudo-Bosch anisotropic fluorocarbon pulse (SF6 / C4F8 / O2)

process_steps.title: Resist Strip, Laser Damage Metrology & Beam Homogenizer Packaging
process_steps.equipment: Downstream Microwave O2 Ashing & Metrology Suite
protocol: O2 microwave plasma ashing (600W, 400 sccm O2, 250 mTorr, 12 min) to completely eliminate sidewall fluorocarbon polymer passivation.
Wet solvent clean: N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) at 70°C for 15 min, followed by IPA and DI cascade rinse.
CD-SEM Inspection: Critical dimension validation across 9-die matrix (w = 310 nm ± 4 nm, pitch = 550 nm).
Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM): Nanopillar height profile h = 420 nm, root-mean-square sidewall roughness Rq < 1.2 nm.
Laser Damage Threshold (LDT) Certification: Tested according to ISO 21254 at 1060 nm (CW & 20ms quasi-CW pulses, fluence > 45 J/cm² verified).
Optical Beam Profiler QA: Beam homogenization uniformity verified (> 94% flat-top plateau over 20 mm x 20 mm aperture; zero central hotspot).
